name: create_skill
description: Create a reusable executable Skill package for an Identity after catalog search found no adequate match. The Skill is loaded as one bounded tool interface on the next Identity reload. Workspace-aware functions may accept optional `_context=None` (omit it from parameters_schema) and resolve files from `_context['workspace']`; do not invent facts absent from evidence.

skill_name.description: Unique snake_case Skill and function name

parameters_schema.description: Complete JSON Schema object. Its properties must exactly match the Python function signature; omit runtime-only _context.

function_code.description: Python defining a top-level function named skill_name
